deals.postCaption: 🍧 Newest gelato opening in Vienna! Summer has officially arrived and it’s hot in Vienna. ❤️‍🔥 We recently visited the new location of @gelato.carlo and we absolutely loved it. It’s honestly some of the best gelato we’ve had in Vienna. In case you didn’t know, there’s a big difference between regular ice cream and gelato. Gelato is denser, smoother and tastes more like a real dessert. 🤤 And there are so many delicious flavors. The pistachio is definitely one of the best we’ve had in Vienna. They have both a vegan and a classic version. We also loved Corsica, it tastes like cream cheese with caramelized figs. Their sorbets are also highly recommended. 🍓 They have changing specials, there’s definitely always something new to try! 🤭 What’s your favorite ice cream or gelato spot in Vienna? 🍨 📍Spiegelgasse 23, 1010 Vienna #gelato #viennafoodblogger #viennafood #wienfood #eiscreme (invitation)
